mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHOP_BOOK ( BOOK_TITLE, AUTHOR, BOOK_PRICE, BOOK_INTRO, PUBLISH_DATE, CATE_NUM ) VALUES ( #{bookTitle}, #{author}, #{bookPrice}, #{bookIntro}, #{publishDate}, #{cateNum} )
INSERT INTO BOOK_IMG ( ORIGIN_FILE_NAME, UPLOAD_FILE_NAME, IS_MAIN, BOOK_NUM ) VALUES ( #{originFileName}, #{uploadFileName}, #{isName}, #{bookNum} )
mapper.select: SELECT B.BOOK_NUM, B.BOOK_TITLE, B.AUTHOR, B.BOOK_PRICE, B.BOOK_INTRO, B.PUBLISH_DATE, B.CATE_NUM, C.CATE_NUM, C.CATE_NAME, I.IMG_NUM, I.ORIGIN_FILE_NAME, I.UPLOAD_FILE_NAME, I.IS_MAIN FROM SHOP_BOOK B LEFT JOIN BOOK_CATEGORY C ON B.CATE_NUM = C.CATE_NUM LEFT JOIN BOOK_IMG I ON B.BOOK_NUM = I.BOOK_NUM AND I.IS_MAIN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.BOOK_NUM DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT B.BOOK_NUM, B.BOOK_TITLE, B.AUTHOR, B.BOOK_PRICE, B.BOOK_STOCK, B.BOOK_INTRO, B.PUBLISH_DATE, B.CATE_NUM, C.CATE_NAME, I.IMG_NUM, I.ORIGIN_FILE_NAME, I.UPLOAD_FILE_NAME, I.IS_MAIN FROM SHOP_BOOK B LEFT JOIN BOOK_CATEGORY C ON B.CATE_NUM = C.CATE_NUM LEFT JOIN BOOK_IMG I ON B.BOOK_NUM = I.BOOK_NUM WHERE B.BOOK_NUM = #{bookNum}

SELECT B.BOOK_NUM, B.BOOK_TITLE, B.AUTHOR, B.BOOK_PRICE, B.BOOK_STOCK, B.BOOK_INTRO, B.PUBLISH_DATE, B.CATE_NUM, C.CATE_NAME FROM SHOP_BOOK B LEFT JOIN BOOK_CATEGORY C ON B.CATE_NUM = C.CATE_NUM WHERE B.CATE_NUM = #{cateNum} ORDER BY B.BOOK_NUM DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SHOP_BOOK B
(B.BOOK_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.AUTHOR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
